name: Nallur Kandaswamy Temple

name: Koneswaram Temple
description: A Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva on a headland overlooking the sea in Trincomalee.

name: Arugam Bay Beach
description: A beach on Sri Lanka’s east coast near Pottuvil, known for surfing.

name: Kankesanthurai Beach
description: A sandy stretch of coast by the port town of Kankesanthurai, commonly called KKS.

name: Delft Island
description: An island southwest of the Jaffna Peninsula, also known as Neduntivu.

name: Kayts
description: A coastal town on Velanai Island west of the Jaffna Peninsula.

name: Point Pedro Jetty
description: A historic wharf on the northern coast at Point Pedro.

name: Elephant Pass
description: The narrow land passage connecting the Jaffna Peninsula to mainland Sri Lanka.

name: Sangupiddy Bridge
description: A road bridge across Jaffna Lagoon linking the peninsula and the mainland along the A32.
